cues.text: After the fight, you, Yukari and Junpei stand together in the car. Yukari glares at Junpei and plants her hands on her hips.
The three of you turn to look about the car. Then it lurches forward with a jolt; the hanging straps swing, and all of you stagger and brace yourselves.
In a burst at the far end of the car, three more Shadows appear between you and the next door: two masked figures and a third between them.
